name: The Prince of Miurna (deceased)
description: Eloped with the Sultana of Caryes; assassinated with her and their young child. Now almost mythic across the Greater Lands.

name: The Sultana of Caryes (deceased)
description: Heir to Caryes and, through her mother, to the Rock of Aphemenosta and the Emirate of Ievure. Assassinated with the Prince and their child.

name: The Lost Heir
description: The child of the Prince and the Sultana, whose body never turned up. A closely guarded rumour. Popular sentiment would likely drive the remaining states to federate under a true heir of the couple.

name: The Emir of Ievure
description: The Sultana's younger brother; holds the Emirate.

name: Incentus I, Lord of the Dells
description: His ideals and writings form a philosophical core of White Raven philosophy and, in rare and illicit tomes, of thaumaturgy.
